title: arabic-led-text-pipeline: Unicode Arabic text rendering for LED dot-matrix displays
description: An open host-to-microcontroller pipeline that renders correctly shaped Unicode Arabic text to monochrome LED dot-matrix displays (P10, MAX7219, and addressable LED chains). Contextual shaping (initial/medial/final forms, ligatures) and rasterisation happen on the host via HarfBuzz and a TrueType font, so the microcontroller receives only a pre-rendered 1-bit framebuffer and needs no font or text logic. Addresses the inability of common closed-source LED controllers, which rely on bitmap fonts, to render cursive right-to-left Arabic correctly.
